content.short: Timeswap is the first oracle-less, permissionless AMM-based lending protocol on Mantle, enabling fixed-term borrowing markets for any token pair.
content.description: Timeswap is a groundbreaking DeFi lending protocol using a three-variable AMM model to create permissionless, oracle-free lending markets for any token pair on Mantle. Without relying on price oracles, Timeswap eliminates oracle manipulation risk entirely while enabling completely permissionless market creation  any token can have a lending market created without governance approval. This design unlocks DeFi lending for the full universe of on-chain assets.
